pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:0.6: ime kho panāyasmanto tiṃsa nissaggiyā pācittiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.1: cīvaravaggo tena samayena buddho bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati gotamake cetiye.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ ticīvaraṃ anuññātaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.3: chabbaggiyā bhikkhū bhagavatā ticīvaraṃ anuññātanti aññeneva ticīvarena gāmaṃ pavisanti, aññena ticīvarena ārāme acchanti, aññena ticīvarena nahānaṃ otaranti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.4: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.5: “kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū atirekacīvaraṃ dhāressantī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.6: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.10: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā atirekacīvaraṃ dhāressatha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.12: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.13.1: “yo pana bhikkhu atirekacīvaraṃ dhāreyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:1.14: evañcidaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.1.1: [mūlapaññatti.] tena kho pana samayena āyasmato ānandassa atirekacīvaraṃ uppannaṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.2: āyasmā ca ānando taṃ cīvaraṃ āyasmato sāriputtassa dātukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.11: atha kho āyasmā ānando bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.14: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.16: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:2.17.1: “niṭṭhitacīvarasmiṃ bhikkhunā ubbhatasmiṃ kaṭhine dasāhaparamaṃ atirekacīvaraṃ dhāretabbaṃ. taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.1.2: bhikkhuno cīvaraṃ kataṃ vā hoti naṭṭhaṃ vā vinaṭṭhaṃ vā daḍḍhaṃ vā cīvarāsā vā upacchinnā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.1.4: aṭṭhannaṃ mātikānaṃ aññatarāya mātikāya ubbhataṃ hoti, saṅghena vā antarā ubbhataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.3: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā puggalassa vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.5: tena bhikkhunā saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā buḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.12: idaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyaṃ saṅghassa nissaṭṭhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.13: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho imaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.14: tena bhikkhunā sambahule bhikkhū upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā buḍḍhānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vanditvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassu vacanīyā:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.21: idaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno nissaggiyaṃ. āyasmantānaṃ nissaṭṭhaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.22: yadāyasmantānaṃ pattakallaṃ, āyasmantā imaṃ cīvaraṃ itthannāmassa bhikkhuno dadeyyu”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:3.2.23: tena bhikkhunā ekaṃ bhikkhuṃ upasaṅkamitvā ekaṃsaṃ uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā ukkuṭikaṃ nisīditvā añjaliṃ paggahetvā evamassa vacanīyo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:4.11: nissaggiyaṃ cīvaraṃ anissajjitvā paribhuñjati, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:4.16: antodasāhaṃ adhiṭṭheti vikappeti vissajjeti nassati vinassati ḍayhati acchinditvā gaṇhanti, vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-np1:5.1: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū nissaṭṭhacīvaraṃ na denti.
